'''Jail guards''' are [[Aggressiveness|aggressive]] bandits found around the [[Draynor Village]] [[Draynor jail|jail]]. They are level 26 and can be dangerous to low level players, especially in numbers, as they are able to wander quite far from the jail and may pursue players on the nearby road or partially into the village. They are equipped with a [[steel mace]], [[leather body]], and [[leather gloves]].

The jail guard with blonde hair is not initially aggressive.
